name: css_catch_mid_exit
description: THE MID-FLIGHT CATCH (USER spec 2026-08-17): remounting a node whose reconciliation identity matches an in-flight zombie must NOT paint a fresh enter next to a still-leaving retained copy. Track flavour: #sidebar exits via flyOutLeft 1s; at t~0.25 the SAME sidebar remounts - the zombie entry is claimed (zombies drops to 0 once the emptied zombie reaps on the next tick) and the LIVE node travels home as a reversed track (no -azul-animation-in is declared, so the reverse of the out-track drives; live_tracks:1 while it runs, 0 when home). The NC direction: a remount AFTER the exit completed is a plain fresh mount - nothing to catch, no live track (no -in declared), no zombies. (Names are @keyframes-declared: there are NO engine builtins - USER ruling - and no default slides; an undeclared unmount just disappears.)

css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
@keyframes flyInLeft { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(0px); } }
@keyframes flyOutLeft { from { transform: translateX(0px); } to { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
#root { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: row; }
#sidebar { width: 200px; height: 100%; background: #2255aa; -azul-animation-out: flyOutLeft 1s; }
#card { flex-grow: 1; height: 100%; background: #cc3333; }
